data.content:
Here's the complete MCP HTTP server setup in `McpHttpServer/`:

**Program.cs** — Wires up the MCP server with HTTP transport:
```csharp
builder.Services.AddMcpServer()
    .WithHttpTransport()        // Enables Streamable HTTP transport
    .WithToolsFromAssembly()    // Auto-discovers [McpServerToolType] classes
    .WithResourcesFromAssembly(); // Auto-discovers [McpServerResourceType] classes

app.MapMcp(); // Maps the /mcp endpoint (POST for JSON-RPC, GET for SSE)
```

**Key points:**

| Concept | How |
|---------|-----|
| HTTP transport | `.WithHttpTransport()` + `app.MapMcp()` |
| Resources | `[McpServerResourceType]` on class, `[McpServerResource(...)]` on method |
| Resource URI | `UriTemplate = "config://app/settings"` (supports `{param}` templates) |
| Tools | `[McpServerToolType]` on class, `[McpServerTool]` on method |
| Descriptions | `[Description("...")]` from `System.ComponentModel` |

**Packages needed:**
- `ModelContextProtocol` (2.0.0-preview.2)
- `ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore` (2.0.0-preview.2)

The server listens on the default `/mcp` endpoint and speaks the MCP Streamable HTTP protocol — clients POST JSON-RPC requests and can optionally receive SSE streams.
